item.title: WhatsApp May Introduce Instagram-Style ‘Close Friends’ Status Sharing Soon
item.description: WhatsApp is testing an Instagram-style Close Friends status feature, allowing users to share updates privately with selected contacts only.

item.title: Businessman’s Son Loses Control Of Lamborghini, Pedestrian Injured In Kanpur
item.description: A Lamborghini driven by a Kanpur businessman’s son veered onto a footpath after an alleged seizure, injuring a pedestrian. Police have seized the car and are verifying medical claims as the probe continues.

item.title: Hyderabad Tragedy: Man Jumps to dead from the 16th Floor in Shaikpet
item.description: A man in Shaikpet residential area, jumped from the 16th floor of a building. He was suffered from illness and depression.

item.title: No traffic allowed on aqueduct bridge from tomorrow
item.description: Rajamahendravaram: Traffic on the Dokka Seethamma aqueduct road bridge over the Vainateya Godavari River at P Gannavaram in Konaseema district will be stopped from February 10, officials said. Water Resources Department DEE B Ravi Prasada Raju said the traffic restriction will remain in force for 42 days. item.title: Rakul Preet Singh gives a glimpse of her rehearsal for 'Pati Patni Aur Woh Do' song
item.description: Mumbai: Actress Rakul Preet Singh is presently busy with her much-talked-about sequel "Pati Patni Aur Woh Do". item.title: T20 WC: Debutants Italy ask Scotland to bat in Group C game
item.description: Kolkata: Italy won the toss and elected to field against Scotland in the Group C match of the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup here at the iconic Eden Gardens. While the two sides do not have a long history in T20 internationals, their recent encounters have produced contrasting results. Scotland and Italy have met twice in T20 internationals, with the head-to-head record evenly poised at 1–1.
